NONE: B2 a bird with a flat face and large eyes that hunts small mammals at night
› also night owl a person who likes to stay up late at night
› A person who is owlish looks serious and intelligent and usually wears glasses.
（人）長得似貓頭鷹的，儒雅嚴肅的

example: He was an owlish figure, sitting in the corner of the library.
他一副很斯文的樣子，坐在圖書館的一角。
